mechanisms.issuer: security control plane after named enrollment authority decision
mechanisms.storage_and_presentation: non-exportable device key; signed nonce; public key and metadata server-side
mechanisms.rotation: overlapping replacement followed by explicit completion and old-key revocation
mechanisms.revocation: immediate credential event plus session invalidation
mechanisms.recovery: manager-assisted re-enrollment with old credential revoked
mechanisms.legacy_adapter: read-only identity bridge; no authority issuance

mechanisms.issuer: security control plane after manager identity proof
mechanisms.storage_and_presentation: WebAuthn/passkey or hardware-backed native key; short bounded session
mechanisms.rotation: new authenticator verified before old authenticator revocation
mechanisms.revocation: credential and all manager sessions revoked
mechanisms.expiry: session expiry mandatory; credential policy expiry recorded
mechanisms.recovery: security-admin supervised re-enrollment; no shared PIN
mechanisms.legacy_adapter: existing trusted-device identity may present only through a fenced adapter

mechanisms.issuer: workload identity authority bound to immutable release-service principal
mechanisms.storage_and_presentation: short-lived workload assertion; no repository or client secret
mechanisms.rotation: automatic issuer-key and workload assertion rotation
mechanisms.revocation: disable workload principal and reject outstanding assertions
mechanisms.recovery: re-provision workload identity after security review

mechanisms.issuer: separate security authority with named-person evidence
mechanisms.storage_and_presentation: hardware-backed phishing-resistant credential and bounded step-up session
mechanisms.rotation: two-credential overlap only during audited rotation
mechanisms.revocation: immediate credential, grant, and session revocation
mechanisms.expiry: step-up session expires rapidly; credential policy expiry recorded
